description: Defines a template class 'pucch_format1_map' that maps elements of type T to PUCCH Format 1 initial cyclic shifts and time domain OCC indices, including iterators, insertion, access, and utility functions.

classes.name: pucch_format1_map
classes.description: A template class that maps elements of type T to PUCCH Format 1 cyclic shifts and OCC indices, with iterator support and utility functions.

classes.name: pucch_format1_map::const_iterator

methods.name: operator*
